verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a REST API and OpenAI-like endpoints, so API versioning and deprecation are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack never mentions API version numbers, version pinning, or any deprecation policy. App release notes (0.3.0, 0.3.5) cover product versions, not a versioned API contract.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
